boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Maryland-Baltimore County
boards.description: Ten currently documented food and campus destinations with evening or overnight availability around UMBC.

cards.title: True Grit's Market
cards.subtitle: UMBC campus, Baltimore, MD
cards.notes: Check UMBC OpenNow before heading over; it lists True Grit's Outtakes as open from 6 a.m. to 3 a.m. for a late campus option.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus market with overnight-listed availability.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC OpenNow lists “True Grit's Outtakes” as open 6 a.m.–3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: UMBC OpenNow currently lists the location as 6 a.m.–3 a.m.; verify the live listing before going.

cards.title: 2.Mato
cards.subtitle: The Commons, UMBC campus
cards.notes: Use the live UMBC OpenNow listing to confirm service before walking over; it currently shows 2.Mato open until 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Commons food counter listed into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC OpenNow currently lists 2.Mato as open from noon to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The live UMBC listing currently shows noon–10 p.m.; campus dining schedules can change.

cards.title: Outtakes (Commons)
cards.subtitle: The Commons, UMBC campus
cards.notes: Check the live UMBC listing before leaving your residence; it currently lists Outtakes in The Commons through 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An evening-listed convenience-food stop in The Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC OpenNow currently lists Outtakes (Commons) as open from noon to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The live UMBC listing currently shows noon–10 p.m.; confirm status before visiting.

cards.title: The Commons
cards.subtitle: 1000 Hilltop Circle, UMBC campus
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday stop around the building schedule; The Commons publishes midnight closing on those two regular-semester nights.
cards.short_summary: UMBC’s student-union building stays open latest on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons lists regular-semester Friday hours of 7:30 a.m.–12 a.m. and Saturday hours of 8 a.m.–12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Regular-semester building hours list midnight closing Friday and Saturday; posted semester and holiday schedules differ.

cards.title: McDonald's on Frederick Road
cards.subtitle: 501 Frederick Rd, Catonsville, MD
cards.notes: For a later pickup, use the drive-thru; the restaurant page lists it as open 24 hours while the lobby closes at midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Frederick Road drive-thru listed around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists this location’s drive-thru as open 24 hours daily and its lobby as open until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 24 hours daily; lobby hours are 6 a.m.–12 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Baltimore National Pike
cards.subtitle: 6200 Baltimore National Pike, Catonsville, MD
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest listed access; the location page gives a 4 a.m. daily drive-thru close and a 10 p.m. dining-room close.
cards.short_summary: A Catonsville drive-thru listed until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this location’s drive-thru hours as 7 a.m.–4 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 4 a.m. daily; dine-in is listed until 10 p.m., so use the appropriate service.

cards.title: Hip Hop Fish & Chicken
cards.subtitle: 6400 Baltimore National Pike, Catonsville, MD
cards.notes: Check Toast before placing an order; its restaurant page lists daily late service, extending to 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Baltimore National Pike counter with late listed ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s Toast page lists hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Hip Hop Fish & Chicken Catonsville – Toast
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 10:15 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:15 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Kiani's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 5808 Johnny Cake Road, Catonsville, MD
cards.notes: Use Kiani's ordering page to check the day’s closing time; it lists midnight on Friday and Saturday and 10:30 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A Johnny Cake Road pizza shop with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Kiani's lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–12 a.m. and Sunday–Thursday hours until 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Weekend service is listed until midnight; Sunday–Thursday service is listed until 10:30 p.m.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Frederick Road
cards.subtitle: 6415 Frederick Road, Catonsville, MD
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order before the published weekend close; this location lists midnight hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Frederick Road pizza option with midnight weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists Friday and Saturday restaurant hours of 10:30 a.m.–12 a.m. at 6415 Frederick Road.
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are listed until midnight Friday and Saturday; other days close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Jennings Cafe
cards.subtitle: 808–810 Frederick Road, Catonsville, MD
cards.notes: For a sit-down meal, aim for Friday or Saturday; Jennings lists its kitchen open until 11 p.m. on both nights.
cards.short_summary: A Catonsville restaurant with an 11 p.m. weekend kitchen close.
cards.evidence_claim: Jennings Cafe lists Friday–Saturday kitchen hours of 11 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen service is listed until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday; the restaurant’s bar hours are not relevant to this card.
